## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Clone repository
git clone git@github.com:org/project.git
cd project

# 2. Install dependencies
npm install

# 3. Copy environment file
cp .env.example .env

# 4. Start services
docker compose up -d

# 5. Run database migrations
npm run db:migrate

# 6. Seed test data
npm run db:seed

# 7. Start application
npm run dev
```
